subject: Vendor onboarding: Solvaris — payment routing preferences
messages:
From: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@solvaris.co>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Solvaris — payment routing preferences

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intro — happy to get Solvaris set up in your system. For the onboarding checklist, a few quick items up front:

- We prefer ACH (USD) as our primary payment method; wire is available for urgent or international invoices.
- Remit-to / invoice submission: invoices should be sent to invoices@solvaris.co and remittance notifications to accounts@solvaris.co.
- PO requirement: please indicate a PO number on the invoice; if your system requires a specific PO format please let me know.
- Payment terms: our standard is Net 30 and we'll accept Net 45 on a case-by-case basis.

I've attached our W-9 and a short bank detail stub for ACH. Let me know if you need a counterparty form filled out by Redwood.

Best,

Emily Nguyen
Head of Finance, Solvaris
emily.nguyen@solvaris.co
Attachment: Solvaris_W9.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Solvaris_ACH_stub.pdf (text/plain)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@solvaris.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Solvaris — payment routing preferences

Hi Emily,

Appreciate the details — this is perfect. Quick checklist from our side to make the vendor record and get AP moving: 

1) Completed vendor onboarding form (attached: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx) — if you can fill out the contact and tax sections that helps us match invoices.
2) W-9 (received) — thanks.
3) Bank details for ACH (received) — we will run a micro-deposit test from our AP account prior to enabling full ACH payments.
4) PO requirement: Redwood AP needs a PO number embedded in the invoice subject or as Invoice -> PO field. Standard format is RDW-##### but we can accept your PO if you provide mapping.
5) Remittance email: accounts@solvaris.co noted. We also capture remittance notification emails in our vendor record — if you have a different preferred address for remits, let us know.

Two asks for you: fill the attached checklist and confirm whether the bank details are for a USD domestic account or an international USD-clearing bank. If international, please provide the correspondent bank info.

I'll loop in Laura and Ben from FinOps/AP to complete the vendor setup.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Accounts Payable <accounts@solvaris.co>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@solvaris.co>
Date: 2026-11-08T08:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Solvaris — payment routing preferences

Hi Markus,

Thanks — attached are the completed items you requested:
- Solvaris_W9.pdf
- Solvaris_ACH_stub.pdf (shows account and routing)

Bank details summary (domestic USD account):
- Bank: First Capital Bank
- Account name: Solvaris Inc.
- Account #: 123456789
- Routing #: 111000025

We confirm this is a US domestic USD account (no correspondent required).

Invoice behavior: please place PO on the invoice in the PO field; our invoices will also include an invoice # and a remit-to email of accounts@solvaris.co. We will send invoices to invoices@solvaris.co.

Payment terms: Net 30. If Redwood requires a different PO prefix for auto-matching, we can add RDW- prefixes to our invoices for the first month of the relationship.

Let us know when you send the ACH micro-deposit and we will confirm receipt.

Regards,

Accounts Payable
Solvaris Inc.
Attachment: Solvaris_W9.pdf
Attachment: Solvaris_ACH_stub.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@solvaris.co>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Solvaris — payment routing preferences

Thanks Emily / Markus — looping in AP to kick off vendor creation. Ben — please create the vendor record for Solvaris and use the following fields:
- Remit email: accounts@solvaris.co
- Invoice email: invoices@solvaris.co
- Payment method: ACH (USD) after micro-deposit verification
- Default payment terms: Net 30
- PO requirement: yes — please enable PO matching using the PO field; accept RDW-##### or a vendor-supplied PO.

Ben, I attached a short AP guidance doc for the micro-deposit flow and what to confirm on the vendor record (AP-Test-ACH-Instructions.pdf). If you hit any mapping issues with the vendor portal let me know and we'll map manually.

Emily — once Ben confirms the record is live we'll schedule the micro-deposit (same-day processing window).

Laura Bennett
Head of FinOps, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: AP-Test-ACH-Instructions.pdf
